scope: The exact 50,000-character model-visible source inputs after applying the adjudicated procedural-history cuts.

relocated_detector_evidence.method: Relocate every verified quote from the post-repair detector output in the cut corpus and recompute each row's strongest tier.
relocated_detector_evidence.note: This is relocation of existing detector evidence, not a new detector pass.

additional_party_position.reason: The sentence expressly reports what the applicant alleged, not a Chamber or Grand Chamber conclusion.

model_input_boundary_review.result: No current-case conclusion, earlier-instance outcome on the scored Article, or current-court merits reasoning.

source_acceptance.method: Each prior source was approved. The cut script proved that only the adjudicated quotes were removed. All newly visible characters caused by the 50,000-character cap and all remaining review spans were read directly.
